name: How long does interior house painting typically take?
description: Interior painting duration varies by project size and complexity, from 1-3 days for a room to 1-2 weeks for an entire house.

mainEntity.name: How long does interior house painting typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of interior painting depends on several factors, including the size of the area, the complexity of the job, and the condition of the walls. A single room might take 1-3 days, while an entire house could range from 1 to 2 weeks. Preparation work, such as patching and priming, often takes significant time. We strive to complete projects efficiently while maintaining quality.
